scheme_name: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a livestock owner
Applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) issued by the state of Haryana
benefits_summary: Provides financial protection against livestock death with subsidised premiums, covering up to five large animals (or equivalent small animals) per household.
